response.text:
I can’t continue working in the background or send results later unless you create a real automation/reminder through an available tool (I have no persistent background process). I can, however, do the research now and deliver results during this session — or help you set up a reminder/automation you can run.

Which would you like?
- I want you to research now: tell me the topic, scope (depth, limits), preferred sources (if any), deliverable format (summary, bullet points, annotated sources), and a deadline/time you want the result by today.
- I want a reminder/automation: tell me what system you use (Google Calendar, Outlook, a task manager) and what to schedule (time, title, notes); I can give step-by-step instructions or draft the calendar/event/email for you to create/send.
- I want a draft to send later: tell me the recipient, tone, and key points and I’ll draft the message now for you to send later.

Which option and details?
